== Notes ==
* Consider combining with hex spells that hex foes in an [[area of effect]], such as [[Reckless Haste]] or [[Suffering]].
* If your target dies while you are casting Feast of Corruption, the spell will not [[fail]].
* You cannot capture this skill from four prominent foes that use it:
** [[Rotscale]], [[Selvetarm]], and [[Fendi Nin]] are [[boss-like foe]]s; you can only capture skills from bosses.
** The death of the [[Inscribed Guardian]] at the end of [[Finding the Bloodstone]] triggers a [[cinematic]], leaving no time to capture the skill.
